items.title: Charles Lloyd — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: George Coleman and he came out, and I was out in Cali now going to USC, and they would come out and we would go to jam sessions and turn the places out and stuff.

ctx.x: And Max invited him to come and be in his band, and George, and stuff like that. George Coleman and he came out, and I was out in Cali now going to USC, and they would come out and we would go to jam sessions and turn the places out and stuff. I remember Charlie Haden made a little derogatory remark like, “That guy’s the king of the eighth notes.” You know, what he was doing with them eighth notes!
